query.description: 배치 한 건 조회 (재전송 판단: 같은 해시면 완료 / 다른 해시면 오류)
query.commandtext: SELECT STREAM_KIND, BATCH_NO, PAYLOAD_SHA256, ITEM_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_IMPORT_BATCH WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq AND STREAM_KIND = :stream_kind AND BATCH_NO = :batch_no

query.description: 배치 완료 기록 (행 저장이 끝난 뒤 마지막에 기록)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_IMPORT_BATCH (IMPORT_JOB_SEQ, STREAM_KIND, BATCH_NO, FORMAT_VERSION, PAYLOAD_SHA256, ITEM_COUNT, POINT_COUNT, PAYLOAD_BYTES) VALUES (:import_job_seq, :stream_kind, :batch_no, :format_version, :payload_sha256, :item_count, :point_count, :payload_bytes)

query.description: 완료 확정: 종류별 배치 수 / 최소 / 최대 번호 (누락 번호 확인)
query.commandtext: SELECT STREAM_KIND, COUNT(*) AS BATCH_COUNT, MIN(BATCH_NO) AS MIN_NO, MAX(BATCH_NO) AS MAX_NO FROM TQP_GDS_IMPORT_BATCH WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq GROUP BY STREAM_KIND

query.description: 저장 작업의 완료 배치 목록 (재개 시 건너뛸 배치)
query.commandtext: SELECT STREAM_KIND, BATCH_NO, PAYLOAD_SHA256 FROM TQP_GDS_IMPORT_BATCH WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq ORDER BY DECODE(STREAM_KIND, 'LAYER', 1, 'SOURCE', 2, 'PLACED', 3, 9), BATCH_NO
